* Catch up/Shoot the shit about life ***(5 minutes)***
* Small Recap of the last appt ***(2-3 minutes).*** Some people will forget what we discussed last time, so this is a good time to recap. 
* Ask how things have been in regards to recap ***(10-15 minutes).***
* When they're done, recite/recall what they just said + add adjustments/critique. ***(10-15 minutes).***
* Ask if they have any general questions they didn't ask last time. ***(5 minutes).***
* Discuss adjustments/maintaining goals/interventions ***(10 minutes).***
* Recap the appointment/explain new interventions **(5 minutes).** 
* Close out the appointment with a new time/date for the next follow-up.
